# Onboarding & Governance Hub - LLM Index

> Central repository for policy specifications, onboarding guidelines, and agent governance.

## Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Workspace overview, system rules, and quickstart checklist.
- [POLICY.md](POLICY.md): Strict safety rules, source of truth hierarchy, tool and agent policies.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Procedural workflows, ticketing system, Docker constraints, and state transitions.

## HOME vs ADOPT
- wellmanifest owns standards (`domain_pack`). Product CLI/daemons HOME in `subactor` or `semcod`.
- `ADOPT wellmanifest/{new-project,dsl,logs}` is not HOME. "w ramach wellmanifest" means ADOPT.
- Emit optional `intent.json` `placement` (`home`, `shape`, `runtimeOwner`, `adopt`) for SERVICE/FEATURE that create a repo. Invalid values fail the schema; missing values stay optional until WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL fills them.
